review.note: M53: CShapes draws this period from 1886-01-01 to 1903-11-16 under gwcode 140 and the atlas gave it to `brazil`, which is why Brazilian ground of the imperial years belonged to the Republic. It is cut at 1889-11-15, the Empire’s dissolution on Wikidata’s Q217230, and the remainder is `brazil-1889`. The outline is the same file and the same key in both halves: nothing was redrawn, and the Republic inherited these borders unchanged.
